falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A decisive break below the key support level would invalidate the breakout thesis and signal that the transition_2020_dec_breakout pattern has failed, shifting the structure from accumulation to distribution

falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A death cross would confirm bearish momentum and contradict the bullish continuation implied by the 75% pattern match, indicating the macro trend has reversed rather than consolidating for a breakout

falsification_conditions.condition: Weekly trading volume fails to exceed 1.5x the 20-week average volume for two consecutive weeks
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Breakout patterns require volume confirmation; sustained low volume would show lack of institutional participation and suggest the current consolidation is distribution rather than accumulation, invalidating the HOLD signal
